name: Voxel Mesh Ray Intersection via BVH
definition: A ray intersection algorithm for voxel meshes that uses a Binary Volume Hierarchy (BVH) to traverse nodes and perform triangle intersection tests on leaf nodes. It handles multiple meshes by first checking bounding boxes and then delegating to the specific mesh's BVH.
summary: Voxel Mesh Ray Intersection via BVH is a raycasting method that traverses a grid of oriented sub-cubes to find intersections with voxel geometry using Binary Volume Hierarchy triangle intersection tests.
